{% set employee = frappe.get_doc("Employee", doc.employee) %}

TERMS & CONDITIONS OF EMPLOYMENT

1. Documents and Evaluation:

Within three business days of your first day of work, you must submit the following documents:

  • Secondary School Certificate mark sheet
  • Last professional exam mark sheet
  • Aadhar and PAN card copies
  • Relieving letter and salary slips/certificates from the last employer

If an employee fails to provide the required documents within three days, employment will be terminated at the discretion of the management.

2. Office Timing:

Office hours are:

  • Staff: 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM
  • Factory Workers: 9:00 AM - 7:00 PM

Late arrivals beyond the 15-minute margin will be marked as half-day.

3. Absence:

Absence for four consecutive days without prior approval may lead to termination without notice.

4. Probation Period:

  • Standard probation: 6 months
  • Trainees: Begins post-training completion
  • Extension up to 1 month if needed
  • Termination during probation may occur without notice for breach of agreement

5. Code of Conduct:

Employees are expected to uphold the company's values:

  • Accountability
  • Commitment
  • Quality

Unacceptable behaviors include:

  • Disrespect to colleagues
  • Substance abuse
  • Harassment
  • Fraud and theft
  • Negligence of responsibilities

Violation may lead to termination without notice.

6. Confidentiality:

  • Employees cannot engage in external commercial activities
  • Confidential company information must not be disclosed
  • Unauthorized document removal is prohibited

7. Non-Compete and Non-Solicit:

  • Employees cannot work with competitors during and up to 1 year after employment
  • Direct or indirect solicitation of clients or employees is prohibited

8. Leave:

  • 12 Earned Leaves & 6 Casual Leaves annually (post-probation)
  • National holidays and festivals are additional

9. Performance Evaluations:

  • Regular performance assessments
  • Areas of improvement will be discussed

10. Termination:

  • 4 weeks' notice or payment in lieu
  • Company reserves right to terminate without notice for misconduct
  • Resigned employees will not receive accrued incentives
  • Full & final settlement processed 30 days post-separation

By signing below, I acknowledge that I have read and understood the above terms:

Employee Name: {{ employee.employee_name }}

Employee ID: {{ employee.name }}

Date: {{ frappe.utils.today() }}

{% if doc.signature %}

Signed by:

{% endif %}

Signature: _____________________
